name: Phase Sensitive Innovations
old_description: PHASE SENSITIVE INNOVATIONS (PSI) specializes in creating and incorporating photonic devices into various RF systems, including 5G wireless communication, high bandwidth RF-over-fiber, and antenna remoting.
about:
Phase Sensitive Innovations (PSI) is a small, high-technology company based in Newark, Delaware, specializing in RF photonic devices, components, and systems with a focus on the millimeter-wave region of the electromagnetic spectrum.

The company designs and manufactures high-speed UTC photodiodes, ultra-high-speed lithium niobate phase modulators (up to 500 GHz), broadband RF photonic links, and tunable optical paired source (TOPS) systems for wideband RF signal synthesis. It provides a full suite of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) capabilities — design, simulation, layout, multi-project wafer submission, and characterization — alongside custom RF design, RF component testing from DC to 1 THz, and RF/optical packaging (flip-chip, wire/ribbon bonding, hermetic sealing). In-house fabrication occupies over 3,000 sq ft of laboratory and cleanroom space, including a 1,200 sq ft ISO Class 6/7 cleanroom for wafer processing up to 6-inch diameter and 1,000+ sq ft for mid- and back-end assembly. The shop also runs a Mazak V500C CNC mill (3-axis and 3D simultaneous) and a 3NTR A2V4 3D printer for multi-material polymer parts.

PSI serves defense, industrial, 5G/6G cellular, radar, satellite, security, and communications markets. Its devices enable millimeter-wave imaging for security scanning and vision enhancement, RF-over-fiber links, antenna remoting, phased-array beamforming, and RF surveillance across microwave, millimeter-wave, and terahertz bands.

The company emphasizes its phase-locking upconversion technology, which it says delivers unprecedented beam-bandwidth processing for next-generation 5G and beyond. It also highlights industry-leading photodiode power handling and linearity, lithium niobate modulators covering the full millimeter-wave spectrum, and an end-to-end PIC design-to-fabrication flow under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system certified by TÜV SÜD.
